name: My Little Friends
summary: A keeper offers you a package to begin studying three small creatures. The Entomology Starter Kit holds the notes and materials for the work.

sections.title: A Keeper’s Offer
sections.body: A keeper who has spent many hours studying a small menagerie offers to share the hobby with you. The package contains notes and materials to begin. With the Entomology Starter Kit, you can seek an Arbor Tarantula, a Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.

faq.q: What does the keeper want me to do?
faq.answer: Use the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, a Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
The package contains notes and materials to get you started with the keeper’s hobby.
The keeper studies the anatomy, diets, and social rituals of the creatures in a small menagerie.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the kit?
faq.answer: The keeper says you will need to purchase another package for a small fee.
